title: Introducing Buffer Reply: Deliver Exceptionally Responsive Customer Support on Twitter
description: Customer service is near and dear to us at Buffer, and we'd love to make great customer service possible for all!  Be among the first to try our brand new customer service tool, Buffer Reply (previously known as Respond).   https://buffer.com/reply  We've been using Buffer Reply every day to support our Twitter community and to join in nearly 300 conversations every day on social. And we're so grateful to count among the Buffer Reply community some of the biggest names in Silicon Valley like Slack, WordPress, Product Hunt, and Stripe who have helped us shape the product into an outstanding Twitter support tool.   With Buffer Reply, we're so eager to have you experience a social-first approach to customer support — featuring a real-time inbox of mentions and keywords with an intuitive, team-centered approach to seamlessly taking care of every customer and conversation.  Here're just a few of the social-first tools in Buffer Reply at launch:   - Real-time tweet inbox - Custom searches - Team collaboration: Signatures, double-reply prevention, assign conversations    Check out Buffer for super simple social media scheduling and analytics: http://buffer.com  Subscribe here so you don't miss our future videos (it's free!) - http://bit.ly/BufferYT  Ask us any questions on social media or here in the comments. We'd love to answer them!   Follow us in these places:  Twitter - https://twitter.com/buffer Facebook - https://www.facebook.com/bufferapp Google+ - https://plus.google.com/+Bufferapp/ Instagram - https://instagram.com/buffer

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents Buffer Reply, also shown as Respond by Buffer, as a software tool for managing Twitter customer-support conversations and related searches, with the sampled frames showing its interface. The visible analytics and conversation-management controls support an ordinary product demonstration and promotion rather than a solicitation involving investment returns, payments, credentials, or other financial participation. Requests to subscribe to the channel and follow Buffer accounts are ordinary audience-engagement requests, not conditions for a financial or data-related offer.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central offer is an ordinary customer-support software service, with its features described and interface shown.
